notes: The regional obesity-trend cross-tab (one of the paper's core PROC SURVEYFREQ calls: STRATA/CLUSTER/WEIGHT/TABLE with NOMCAR and ROW CHISQ), copied verbatim from obesity_sex_stratified.sas. The private KNHANES extract normally read via LIBNAME A is replaced with a 12-row MOCK dataset matching the columns the statements reference (year, sex, region_re, obe, kstrata, psu, wt_pool_2). Unlike PROC SURVEYLOGISTIC (see t005), Jenner accepts NOMCAR on PROC SURVEYFREQ without modification.
